q1.query: Why does VGG use small 3x3 convolutional filters?
q1.rewritten_query: VGG small 3x3 convolutional filters receptive field size rationale
q1.hypothetical_document: VGG networks use small 3x3 convolutional filters to reduce the number of parameters while increasing the depth of the network. Stacking multiple 3x3 filters achieves the same effective receptive field as larger filters but with fewer weights and additional nonlinearities, improving representational capacity.
